name: Hearthfold Vale

locations.name: Greenwell Commons
locations.flavor: Picnic lawns around a mossy well; kids race paper boats in the runoff.

locations.name: Willowpond
locations.flavor: Willows dip into clear water; anglers trade gossip louder than fish.

locations.name: Market Row
locations.flavor: Canvas awnings, herb bundles, and copper pots; prices drop at dusk.

locations.name: Old Stonebridge
locations.flavor: Three arches over the slow river; lovers carve initials (rangers frown).

locations.name: The Hearthkeeper Statue
locations.flavor: A hooded figure offering bread; festival ribbons appear without warning.

locations.name: Vale Primer Yard
locations.flavor: Chalk boards under a tin roof; first letters, first wooden practice blades.

locations.name: Cottage Lane
locations.flavor: Shared fences, herb gardens, and laundry lines that double as gossip wires.

locations.name: Low Watchpost
locations.flavor: A timber tower with a brass bell; apprentices learn who to trust after dark.

feel: Starting green lowlands; home villages, ponds, stone bridges

name: Glassmarket Coast

locations.name: Lantern Quay
locations.flavor: Boardwalk lamps glow teal; street musicians duel for coin bowls.

locations.name: Mirrorglass Stalls
locations.flavor: Polished trays, imported dyes, and sharp-tongued brokers.

locations.name: Tidepool Court
locations.flavor: Salt ponds framed by mosaics; children dare each other to skip stones.

locations.name: Envoy of Scales
locations.flavor: A merchant-saint with balanced pans; oaths sworn here hold in court.

locations.name: Caravan Yard
locations.flavor: Wagons, mounts, and stamped travel writs — unlocks inter-region trips.

locations.name: Ledger Hall
locations.flavor: Contracts, bonds, and apprenticeship seals stamped in blue wax.

locations.name: Saltbreeze Healer Post
locations.flavor: Clean linen, bitter tonics, and a queue that never quite empties.

feel: Trade city, stalls, harbor lamps, negotiators

name: Thornreed Wilds

locations.name: Reedpath Trail
locations.flavor: Tall reeds hide deer and bandits alike; stick to the marked stakes.

locations.name: Standing Stone Ring
locations.flavor: Crooked menhirs; night wind sounds like whispered names.

locations.name: Foragers’ Camp
locations.flavor: Drying racks for herbs and fruits; mentors teach what *not* to chew.

locations.name: Black Mirror Pond
locations.flavor: Still water shows stars at noon if the clouds play along.

locations.name: Thornreed Wayshrine
locations.flavor: A cracked guardian statue; travelers leave fruit, not coins.

locations.name: Ashen Gate (ruin)
locations.flavor: One sealed arch with cold breath behind it — endgame-curious events only.

feel: Brush paths, standing stones, foraging camps

locations.name: Spireward Collegium
locations.flavor: Lecture yards, rune chalk, and exams that smell of ozone.

locations.name: Founders’ Statue Garden
locations.flavor: Busts of scholars; students leave chalk jokes on the plinths.

locations.name: Inkpond Cloister
locations.flavor: Black swans (rumored ink-stained) and quiet study benches.

locations.name: Scribe Stalls
locations.flavor: Quills, blank codices, and gossip about which professor failed whom.

locations.name: Practice Lawn
locations.flavor: Soft turf for supervised spars; healers wait under a striped awning.

locations.name: Archive Steps
locations.flavor: Wide stairs to sealed stacks; Codex discoveries often start here.

name: Emberlight Marches

locations.name: Forge Plaza
locations.flavor: Anvil song, spark showers, and armor fittings that never quite fit first try.

locations.name: Emberlight Drill Hall
locations.flavor: Line drills, wooden posts, and instructors who never raise their voice twice.

locations.name: Redlamp Fort
locations.flavor: Signal fires on the wall; caravans pay for escort writs.

locations.name: Ashflower Park
locations.flavor: Tough blooms in black soil; veterans picnic between deployments.

locations.name: Ember Pond
locations.flavor: Warm mineral water; steam in winter, fireflies in summer.

locations.name: Marchwarden Statue
locations.flavor: A nameless captain pointing east; kids climb the boots until scolded.

locations.name: Deep Vault Threshold
locations.flavor: Second and last ruin pin — relic rumors, not a cave crawl loop.

feel: Frontier forts, forge towns, rare ruin gates
